resources.string: To mark your attendance, ensure your current office location is correctly identified.
Your current position will become the new office location. Attendance will then be checked against it.
You are %1$s away from the office
Set the office location to start checking your distance.
Allow precise location to see how far you are from the office.
Turn on location to see how far you are from the office.
Searching for a location fix. Moving near a window or outdoors helps.
You are %1$s from the office. You can mark attendance now.
You are %1$s away from the office. Move within %2$d meters of the designated office location to enable check-in.
Your location is only accurate to ±%1$d m. Check-in needs ±%2$d m or better; moving near a window or outdoors helps.
Your location\'s accuracy is unknown, so check-in stays locked until a more precise fix arrives.
Opens within %1$d m of the office
Last marked today at %1$s, %2$s from the office
Location permission is needed to set the office and check your distance.
Location permission is turned off for this app. Allow it in Settings to continue.
Precise location is needed. Approximate location can be off by more than the 50 m check-in radius.
Location is turned off on this device.
Couldn\'t get a location fix. Move somewhere with a clearer view of the sky and try again.
Your location isn\'t precise enough to save as the office. It needs to be accurate to ±50 m or better; moving near a window or outdoors helps.
The office location couldn\'t be saved. Please try again.
Your location changed before attendance was marked. Check your distance and try again.
Attendance couldn\'t be saved. Please try again.
